notes.title: Great news! Farm Frenzy:Heave Ho is available on Steam now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the new chapter of Scarlett adventures  is on Steam now!
[h1]And It has a special price for Steam audience![/h1] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/395930/][img]https://pp.vk.me/c622726/v622726644/3ecc9/csNpsQz0e5I.jpg[/img][/url]
Also We are glad to provide [b]Special launch discount 20%[/b] for full week to celebrate It!
[i]*Special launch discount 20% ends at 2nd of September![/i]
